platforms.name: When The Horn Blows Direct Editorial Email Routes
platforms.country: United Kingdom / London-based global music website
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or mandatory paid route is stated on the official About/Contact page. The separate Donate navigation item is not part of the editorial submission route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: When The Horn Blows publishes separate purpose-labelled editorial mailboxes: Anthony Adams for live content, photography, artist features and album reviews, and assistant editors Dave Beach, Laura Rosierse and Matthew Caslin for track reviews or news. A human must select exactly one appropriate recipient, confirm that the chosen MarcsMusic release fits the publication and requested coverage type, prepare a concise non-duplicative pitch, verify streaming and download-link permissions, and approve all final metadata and assets. Do not mass-email the team or use the recruitment mailbox.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from the official When The Horn Blows About/Contact page. The official page publicly lists anthony@whenthehornblows.com for live content, photography, artist features and album reviews; dave@whenthehornblows.com, Laura@whenthehornblows.com and matt@whenthehornblows.com for track reviews or news; and wow@whenthehornblows.com only for joining the team, which is excluded from music outreach. Publication purpose, syntax and same-domain ownership were confirmed from the first-party page; no SMTP, MX or mailbox-level deliverability probe was performed. The site states that it is open to all genres and mainly covers Indie, Folk, Singer-Songwriter, Rock and Electronic pop. Current activity was verified from first-party posts dated 2026-07-06 and multiple features dated 2026-06-29. No email, message, track link, audio, artwork, EPK, biography or file was sent, and no login, CAPTCHA, payment or anti-bot workflow was used.
